notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix enemy to be more reasonable.
[*] Add stamina in both inn and guild.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Version - 1.0.4 (Content Update - Dojo)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now go to Dojo to train your stats if you get tired of battling and getting defeated.
[*] But beware that there are mini-games for each of the stats improvement.
[*] There is also stamina bar included now. If you train constantly and run out of stamina, you won't be able to train anymore or battle. You will need to rest at an inn in order to get your stamina back. So choose wisely.
[*] Update the enemies so that they are tougher.

[/list]

notes.title: Update Plan Part 1
notes.content:
Hi guys, the following will be the upcoming update plan for the game. There will total of 2 update plan for now and this is part 1. Please note that the update will be released 1 by 1.

[list]
[*] [b]Dojo[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now improve the stats outside of battling and leveling up. With this feature, for each attribute, you have to play mini-game for it and if you do so successfully, you will raise a point. This feature also include stamina management. So you have to think twice of whether you want to battle or train.
[/list]
[*] [b]Add more Attack Cards and Enemies.[/b]
[*] [b]Random Events[/b]
[list]
[*] This feature will add random events that will be devastating to the player or very good for the player. For example, a rival will try to sabotage you during your ascending to the tower. This is all to make sure that every single day is eventful and nerve wrecking for the player.
[/list]
[/list]
